headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 9, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the San Francisco Giants, securing a 10-0 victory. Kazuma Okamoto led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs. The Chicago Cubs secured a 9-7 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Pete Crow-Armstrong leading the charge at the plate. Crow-Armstrong's impressive performance included two home runs and two RBIs. The Atlanta Braves secured a shutout victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Dylan Dodd earning the win.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, impacting their teams' lineups. Owen Caissie, a right fielder for the Miami Marlins, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right calf strain. John King, a left-handed pitcher for the Miami Marlins, has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 8, 2026, due to a left lateral ankle sprain. Other players on the injured list include Tim Herrin, a left-handed pitcher for the Cleveland Guardians, Ranger Suarez, a left-handed pitcher for the Boston Red Sox, Connor Prielipp, a left-handed pitcher for the Minnesota Twins, Samad Taylor, a left fielder for the San Diego Padres, Marco Raya, a right-handed pitcher for the Minnesota Twins, and Endy Rodríguez, a catcher for the Pittsburgh Pirates.

The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers, who received cash in return. The Minnesota Twins have acquired right-handed pitcher Woo-Suk Go in a trade with the Detroit Tigers, who received cash in return. The Cleveland Guardians have acquired right-handed pitcher Ryan Degges in a trade with the Philadelphia Phillies, who received cash in return. The Washington Nationals have acquired left-handed pitcher Tom Cosgrove in a trade with the Houston Astros, who received cash in return.
